text:
Elena: Quick thread to finalize May webinar format. Two options: (A) Benchmark story + panel + short demo clip, or (B) Hands-on lab (live). Thoughts?
Sam: Leaning A for scale + lead gen. Less ops risk. :thumbsup:
Matt: A + 1 short demo clip (3-5m) to show latency wins. I'll take the demo clip.
Anya: Lab is tempting but higher support overhead. If we must do interactive, pre-record the lab.
Kai: Ops note: live demo needs fallback recording and a dedicated VM. Also need registration -> SF queue mapping.
Elena: Okay, decision: format A + demo clip. Panel = 3 speakers: PM, Eng, Customer. Who can commit?
Matt: Eng speaker here. Can present perf charts and handle the demo clip.
Sam: I'll reach out to customers we worked with. Prefer one with clear cost-savings results.
Anya: I'll write the abstract and make the slide template. Posting draft by EOD Wed.
Elena: Please include audience callout (developers & platform teams). Need abstract for invite ASAP.
Anya: Draft abstract:
"Redwood Inference: Practical economics of production LLMs — Join Redwood product and engineering to walk through real-world benchmarks, deployment patterns, and concrete levers (caching, batching, model variants) that reduce latency and cost without compromising quality. Hear a customer case study and see a short runtime demo. Ideal for engineers and platform teams."
Sam: Nice. Add CTA about a gated artifact with prompt sets to reproduce the benchmarks.
Anya: Added note about gated prompt set for the post-webinar recap.
Elena: Timing: 60 minutes total: 35m talk, 20m panel Q&A, 5m demo. Rehearsal one week prior. Suggested rehearsal slots: Tue 10:00 or Thu 15:00 next week. Preferences?
Matt: Thu 15:00 works.
Sam: Thu 15:00 good for me.
Anya: Thu 15:00 reserved. I'll send calendar invite and rehearsal agenda.
Kai: Registration mapping: use SF queue "Webinars/Product/Inbound" owner sam@redwood. Also add hidden field interest=benchmarks and tag attended_demo when they click demo CTA. Webhook payload we need in the form redirect:

POST /lead-capture
{
  "source": "webinar_may",
  "queue": "Webinars/Product/Inbound",
  "owner": "sam@redwood"
}

Elena: Perfect. Speakers slide checklist (keep <=12 slides):
- 1-2 slides: company/context
- 5-6 slides: benchmarks (charts + callouts)
- 1-2 slides: customer outcome
- 1 slide: demo screenshot + link to clip
- 1 final CTA slide with gated resource link
Matt: Will post slide draft by Monday. I'll include raw data snippet for the gated download.
Sam: I'll confirm customer speaker by EOD Friday. If they decline, we'll present their case study as a readout.
Anya: Run-of-show for rehearsal:
0:00 Tech check (Elena)
0:05 Intro + product story (Anya)
0:15 Benchmarks deep-dive (Matt)
0:35 Customer case study (Sam)
0:45 Demo clip play (Matt)
0:50 Panel Q&A (All)
0:58 CTA + next steps (Elena)
1:00 End
Elena: Promo plan: invite email + two reminder drips, LinkedIn posts D-0 and D+1, and a short blog recap with the key charts + gated prompt set. Sam to own the blog recap.
Sam: I'll do the recap and the gated artifact. Will coordinate with eng for the prompt set.
Kai: Ops checklist: upload demo clip to CDN 48h prior, test player embed in landing page, verify webinar platform recordings route to team drive.
Anya: Remind presenters to upload final slides 48h before live. I'll add that to the invite and the rehearsal agenda.
webinar-bot: Reminder scheduled: rehearsal invite will be sent to participants at 2445567900.
Elena: Thanks all. I'll publish the invite copy after Anya posts the final abstract. Flag blockers here. :rocket:
